01 THE THROUGHLINE

The work here starts with a useful question: what should this system make easier?

Across the repositories, the pattern is practical: reliable Java and Spring foundations, local-first AI experiments, native Android exploration, and interfaces that make complex workflows approachable.

SUMMARY READY
01 / JAVA + SPRING BOOT 2026

Briefly

A local-first document and web-page summarizer. It supports file uploads, public URL analysis, offline extractive summaries, and an optional local Ollama connection — with export paths for TXT, DOCX, and PDF.

  • Java 17
  • Spring Boot
  • Ollama
  • Gradle
Inspect the repository ↗
02 / SPRING ECOSYSTEM 2026
log( )→✓

Automatic Logging Starter

A Spring Boot starter for automatic method and HTTP-request logging via SLF4J. Add the dependency, enable it once, and keep application code free of scattered logging calls.

  • Java 17
  • Spring Boot 3.5
  • SLF4J

03 / ANDROID + LOCAL AI 2026

Local AI Helper

An Android app for local GGUF chat and screen-text assistance. It combines llama.cpp inference with MediaProjection and ML Kit OCR, keeping the conversation and visible-text context deliberately separate.

  • Kotlin
  • llama.cpp
  • ML Kit

04 / ANDROID GAMEPLAY 2026

Emberfall

A lightweight Android survival RPG built without a heavy game engine. The project documents procedural biomes, real-time survival systems, crafting, and an optional C++/Vulkan renderer.

  • Kotlin
  • Canvas / SurfaceView
  • C++ / Vulkan
